items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Orrin Keepnews who was my partner in Milestone Records gave me a certain amount of work when he started doing all these reissues.

ctx.x: I’ve got to remember that Fats Waller story, which album I wrote it in, because I don’t know if it was Carmen’s or not and it’s bugging me what it was. Because what would be the connection. Okay. Boing, the bell went on. I wrote the notes to — Orrin Keepnews who was my partner in Milestone Records gave me a certain amount of work when he started doing all these reissues. And one of the assignments was not too many years ago in the 90s, was a Fats Waller compilation, which was fun, because I loved all that. So in…
that he was married to Carmen, so there he was leading this date for her so they became friends I guess eventually.
